items.name: Bluetooth: Enumerate Radio Power-Management State
items.description: Lists Bluetooth radios and device power-management capabilities for manual tuning and diagnostics.

steps.command: Get-PnpDevice -Class Bluetooth -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Status,FriendlyName,InstanceId | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output

items.name: Bluetooth: Disable Selective Suspend (registry policy helper)
items.description: Applies a conservative USB-level selective suspend policy commonly affecting Bluetooth adapters; verify adapter behavior after apply.

items.name: Bluetooth: Disable Adapter Power Management where available
items.description: Attempts to disable PnP-level power saving on Bluetooth radios that expose power management capabilities.

steps.command: $radios=Get-PnpDevice -Class Bluetooth -Status OK -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; foreach($r in $radios){ try{ $id=$r.InstanceId.Replace("\","\\"); powercfg /devicedisablewake "$($r.FriendlyName)" | Out-Null }catch{} }; Get-PnpDevice -Class Bluetooth -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FriendlyName,Status | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String | Write-Output

items.name: Bluetooth: List Wake-Armed Bluetooth Devices
items.description: Lists Bluetooth devices currently armed for wake.

items.name: Bluetooth: Export Device and Power Inventory
items.description: Exports Bluetooth PnP inventory for machine-specific tuning in Experimental pages.

steps.command: $ts=Get-Date -Format yyyyMMdd-HHmmss; $dir=Join-Path $PWD "logs"; if(!(Test-Path $dir)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir|Out-Null}; $out=Join-Path $dir ("bluetooth-inventory-"+$ts+".json"); Get-PnpDevice -Class Bluetooth -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FriendlyName,InstanceId,Status,Class | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Out-File -Encoding utf8 $out; Write-Output "Saved: $out"
